motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and disclosure state changes only.

motion.name: brand-rise
motion.purpose: Introductory lockup fades in and rises 10px once; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: brand-progress
motion.purpose: Indeterminate startup activity segment; static under reduced motion, with status text providing meaning.

components.name: Chat Composer
components.description: Rounded message-entry surface with a width-aware editor and compact, accessible send controls.
components.css: .ds-chat-composer { container-type: inline-size; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle); border-radius: 28px; background: var(--color-bg-tertiary); transition: border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-chat-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-chat-editor { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 76px; max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; padding: 18px 20px 12px; color: var(--color-text-primary); font: 400 16px/26px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chat-editor::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-tertiary); } .ds-chat-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 6px 12px 12px; } .ds-chat-tools { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-chat-ghost { display: inline-flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font: 500 12px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chat-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-bg-hover); color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-chat-ghost:focus-visible, .ds-chat-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chat-attachment { width: 36px; padding: 0; } .ds-chat-attachment svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-chat-model { min-width: 0; max-width: 208px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chat-send { display: inline-flex; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: 0 0 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-foreground); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chat-send:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-chat-send svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } @container (max-width: 600px) { .ds-chat-toolbar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; } .ds-chat-tools { flex-wrap: nowrap; } .ds-chat-send { align-self: flex-end; } } @container (max-width: 420px) { .ds-chat-model-provider { display: none; } }

components.name: Mezair startup lockup
components.description: Bounded preview of the full-viewport startup identity. The 44px wordmark and fully rounded 2px progress line are intentional brand exceptions; normal UI typography and radii stay unchanged.
components.css: .ds-mezair-splash { display: grid; min-height: 360px; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; color: var(--color-text-primary, #f8fbff); background: var(--color-bg-primary, #0b1020); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-mezair-lockup { display: flex; width: min(520px, calc(100% - 48px)); flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding-bottom: 2vh; animation: ds-mezair-rise 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-mezair-mark { display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 176px; height: 176px; } .ds-mezair-wordmark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-mezair-wordmark span { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; } .ds-mezair-wordmark small { color: var(--color-text-secondary, #cbd6e6); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-mezair-status { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #cbd6e6); font-size: 12px; } .ds-mezair-progress { width: min(220px, 62vw); height: 2px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-border-subtle, #33415f); } .ds-mezair-progress span { display: block; width: 40%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; animation: ds-mezair-progress 1.3s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-mezair-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @keyframes ds-mezair-progress { from { transform: translateX(-110%); } to { transform: translateX(350%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mezair-lockup, .ds-mezair-progress span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: A restrained dark desktop system for sustained technical work. Conversation and current task stay dominant while operational detail is progressively disclosed.
keyCharacteristics: A monochrome horse-M identity, with may-ZAIR on introductory lockups.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange marks selection or action, never decoration.

rules.name: The Conversation Rule
rules.body: Tool metadata must not fracture assistant prose.

rules.name: The Brand Lockup Rule
rules.body: The startup wordmark uses 44px as an intentional brand exception; it does not expand the normal interface type scale.

dos: Do keep workspace-scoped state correct before rendering it.
Do group operational events by turn and reveal details on demand.
Do reuse the approved monochrome horse-M and reserve may-ZAIR for introductory lockups.
donts: Don't use dashboard clutter, nested-card sprawl, or decorative status chrome.
Don't allow stale cross-workspace content or fragmented assistant prose.
Don't apply the 44px startup wordmark or fully rounded progress-line radius to ordinary interface elements.
